d: In this episode of Finest Homes we take a look at a 21st Century family home built with a variety of materials. We chat to acclaimed architect and homeowner Gregory Katz, who designed this out of the box home. We also give you tips and ideas to achieve this look in your own home.

In this episode of Finest Homes we take a look at a luxury apartment development that stands proud on the architectural stage, and serves as a key urban space, right in the heart of Sandton. We also give you tips and ideas to achieve this look in your own home.
Chris, Jo and Alice are very active seventy somethings. Will Jo's Venetian style pasta or Alice's Thai chicken curry make the biggest impression on Chris?
In the village of Dunboyne in County Meath, Dublin bus scheduler Gavin has shared a house with his mother Sharon since they moved from Enfield when he was a teenager.
In episode 1 of Duncan's Thai Kitchen, Duncan travels to the white sandy beaches that line the gulf of Thailand, and visit the bustling night markets in Hua Hin and Chantaburi.
After travelling north to Bangkok, Duncan cooks a roasted red duck curry at a Royal residence before taking to the streets to cook some of famous street food.

Chetna and Bhups have moved around a lot. They've live in L.A., Britain and Asia. In January 2009, they bought a house and settled in Canada. Because they have been moving around a lot, they haven't had a change to collect heirloom pieces. They want their living/dining space to reflect their personalities and feel like it's been decorated over time - as if they added pieces as they found them.

Sam's Mom, Colleen Pynn hasn't had the time to re-decorate her home. She has been in this house for 14 years and she's always liked it just the way it is. But over the past few years, she's started to softy ask Sam about re-designing her kitchen. Colleen is one of the "greenest" people we've had on the show so far (so it's no surprise that sustainable design is important to her daughter).

Diogo is a dedicated musician working on his new album. He has been debating between moving to Miami or staying in Canada. Toronto is closer to his family and where he feels at home with his music. Danielle will show him some spectacular properties in both cities and see what he decides.

Elizabeth and Michael are retired and want to move closer to their kids and grandchildren. They want to downsize from their two-story house into a bungalow. Luckily, Eve knows all about luxury bungalows. Elizabeth loves to exercise and really would like a gym. Michael has a passion for cars and needs at least a three-car garage.
